You know Cory, I loved your take on this game and the choices you made. While I'm a Visi shipper with Robert, I didn't see what would happen if you cut her and then basically have Robert tell Courtney how he has been failing her as a mentor. It reminded me of Anakin and Obi Wan where he realized too late that if Obi Wan was more aware of Anakins feelings "fear, anger, hate, and suffering" maybe things could have gone different. Visi while she is confessing her feelings to Robert in how she wants to be a hero, which I believe specifically his hero. Also wants to see if Robert will either commit to loving her or not. The game heavily implies even if you romance Blazer that Robert according to Chase likes Visi, and even Royd sees the tension between the two. With how you set everything up and reacted, it does show me that Visi was the more narrative drive, and fulling moment that made this game special for it test these 2 themes.

1. Can someone be given a second chance in life when they have fallen so far?
2. How far will you go for the one you love.
